CI Capital expects lower gas allocations to weigh on Abu Qir, Mopco and Valmore's Alexfert in the fourth quarter and possibly through 2027; granular urea is fetching about $535 a ton FOB, up 17% since September.

Told the EGX it reduced its natural gas intake from 1 November after receiving a supply-cut notice, without giving the percentage; production continues under contingency plans for inventory and rescheduled maintenance. Kima and Mopco each reported a 20% cut. The stock fell 3.6% to EGP 77.71.
Unaudited nine-month profit rose to about EGP 12.97bn, roughly double a year earlier, helped by steadier gas supplies.

The board awarded the second phase of its solar plants, about 3 MW for EGP 76.2m over 12 months, to the Arab Organization for Industrialization, and approved a McKinsey-drafted strategy to start in fiscal 2027.

news.text: Fitch called the EGP 36.4bn offering of 45% of the bank, the largest by value in the EGX's history, an important step toward Egypt's divestment targets; no rating action.

The state's offering of 45% (raised from 30%) raised EGP 36bn; the institutional tranche was covered 7 times and the retail tranche 27 times, said Hisham El Sayed of the state-owned companies unit. It was the EGX's most traded stock of the week, EGP 3.49bn, closing at EGP 5.58 (+5.3%) (Youm7).
Second session: closed at EGP 5.38 (+1.32%) on 147m shares worth EGP 787.8m, the most traded stock on the exchange; one source.

Debut: closed at EGP 5.31, up 0.19% on the EGP 5.30 offer price, after EGP 5.68 early and EGP 5.25 low; 373.1m shares traded worth EGP 2.02bn. The Finance Ministry will take up to half of the EGP 36.37bn raised.
Banque du Caire's EGP 36.4bn offering of 45% of the bank was executed at EGP 5.30 a share; the retail tranche was about 27 times covered. Trading starts on Monday 2 November.

Its CEO told Youm7 the company earned about EGP 15.4bn on EGP 53bn of revenue last fiscal year, sales rose to about 320,000 tons, exports are about $650m against a $1bn goal, and a 300,000-ton expansion with Trafigura is planned.

The government is weighing a large stake sale on the EGX before year-end, size pending a fair-value study; the state holds about 90% through MIH and the real public float is near 3%. The cash dividend's right ends after the 16 November session.

The exchange says the right to the cash coupon (EGP 16 a share from 19 November) ends after the session of Monday 16 November; one report says the assembly approved EGP 15, so the amount is unconfirmed.
